text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm pushing the final weights to s3 for the `nebula-7b-v2` onboarding. Path: `s3://redwood-weights/nebula/nebula-7b-v2/2026-03-10/weights.tar.gz`

alex: Thanks — I'll update the model config in the repo. Reminder: the serving config needs `kv_cache: enabled` and the new `rotary_scaling` flag set.

jon: Heads-up about tokenizer: I saw a split on the byte pair for `#_FUNC` on the new vocab, which breaks one of the tool-calling golden prompts (structured output expects a single token). Can we map it as a special token?

maria: Yep that's on my list. I can add a `special_tokens.json` patch to the S3 bundle — map `#_FUNC` -> `<<FUNC>>`. Will that be compatible with current tokenizer loader?

alex: It will, but you also need to bump `tokenizer_revision` in model config to `r3`. Serving runtime picks tokenizer by that field. If not bumped, runtime will pull old vocab.

sam: Also saw a CI failure in the config validation step: `serving-config.yaml` fails `schema:tool_calling` check. Error: `expected 'tool_schema' when tool_calling.enabled == true`

maria: Oof thanks. I forgot to include the `tool_schema` object for the calculator tool in the PR. I'll add a minimal schema and re-run validation.

alex: Can someone run the golden regression harness after you push the tokenizer patch? I want a quick pass on structured outputs + tool calling before we request Dedicated rollout.

jon: I can run the golden set locally — will take ~20m. Which commit should I point it at?

maria: Use `refs/tags/nebula-7b-v2-rc1` — weights and tokenizer patch will land there once CI passes.

sam: I'll re-run the config linter and CI once Maria pushes. If it still fails, paste the `ytt` rendered output here and I can debug the schema merge.

ciara-bot: deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for refs/tags/nebula-7b-v2-rc1 (build 243). Status: queued.

jon: Running golden harness now against the bucket path and the tag. Will post a short summary in ~25m.

alex: Also — small code review ping: I left one comment in the model-config PR about `max_batch_size` defaulting to 128; suggest 64 for the initial rollout to protect latency. Please respond so I can approve.

maria: Ack on the review. I'll change to 64 and add a note to the rollout playbook.

jon: Quick results: 120/128 structured golden prompts matched expected JSON shape. 8 failures: 5 are tokenizer-splitting issues (I think the `<<FUNC>>` patch will fix 4), 2 are ordering diffs in tool args (non-deterministic), 1 is a timeout on tool-caller (maybe needs slightly higher tool timeout).

alex: Good catch. For non-deterministic arg ordering we should normalize by sorting keys in the golden comparator. Sam, can you open a small follow-up to normalize the eval comparator?

sam: Yep will do after CI completes.

maria: Pushed `special_tokens.json` and bumped tokenizer_revision to `r3`. Also added minimal `tool_schema` for `calculator` and changed `max_batch_size` to 64. PR -> #4126.

ciara-bot: deploy-bot: CI build 243: success. Artifacts uploaded: weights manifest, tokenizer r3, serving-config v0.9.

alex: Approving the PR now. Jon — can you re-run the golden harness against build 243 artifacts and paste the diff link?

jon: Re-run started. I'll post results in this thread.

jon: Final run: 126/128 match. 2 remaining failures: both are ordering diffs in tool args. No tokenizer splits, timeouts fixed. Looks good to me for canary.

alex: Awesome. Action items: sam to open comparator PR, maria to file rollout request for canary with Dedicated ops, jon to run canary once rollout is scheduled. I'll attach the golden run log to the PR.

maria: Filing the rollout request now. Thanks all! :tada:
